dedupe_keys.name: catalogo nacional de hospitales spain directory of all hospitals in operation with beds class ownership and address

description: The national hospital catalogue lists every hospital operating in Spain at the end of each year, public and private, with its number of installed beds, type and owner. It is published annually by the Spanish Ministry of Health as part of the National Health System information system; the 2025 edition describes hospitals in operation on 31 December 2024. The Excel file has a directory of about 850 hospitals with national codes, name, address, municipality, province and autonomous community, postcode, bed count, class of centre (such as general hospitals), functional dependency (regional health services, other public bodies or private owners) and membership of hospital complexes, plus sheets listing openings and closures during the year and code tables. The catalogue is free and available as an Excel download or PDF, with microdata files and an interactive search of hospitals, health centres and out-of-hospital urgent care centres. Caveats: there are no coordinates, bed counts are the only capacity measure, and some hospitals are grouped into complexes that span several sites. Simulation uses: building the hospital inventory for hazard exposure and accessibility analysis, sizing regional bed capacity, and planning evacuation or surge in emergencies. Related records: the Spain hospital accessibility data (data-spain-hospital-accessibility-census-tracts) builds travel times to hospitals, and the French SAE (data-drees-sae-hospital-annual-statistics) is a neighbouring national inventory.
